extracted.name: Potato Salad
extracted.description: This potato salad is easy to make with red potatoes, pickles, hard-boiled eggs, and a creamy dressing for a favorite side at any summer BBQ!
instruction_lines: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. Return potatoes to the empty pot to dry and cool.
Stir mayonnaise, pickles, hard-cooked eggs, red onion, celery, mustard, and cider vinegar together in a large bowl; season to taste with salt and pepper.
Fold in cooled potatoes until well combined.
For best results, store potato salad in the refrigerator until chilled or overnight before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
